posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked: Thanks for the thanks, but I’m pretty sure we’re even at the very least. You guys made a game so fun that my wife, daughter and I regularly lay on the floor with your cards between us, having multiple family fun game nights of face-to-face interaction and enjoyment. Not to mention the fact that making all the accessories for your game has acted as a needed creative outlet for me, which I’d been missing since I stopped making WoW vids. posts.name: MythosD
posts.cooked: I know I’ve just recently joined this community and got my copy of the core game but already it has become a classic among my friends and I. This is an amazing game beyond the great art, story, and mechanics but because I get to actually work with my friends instead of work against them. Thank you for making this game that is contributing to the close bond that I share with my friends and my brother. I don’t even leave the game on a shelf anymore it stays in the car just in case we have to feed our addiction at that very moment. Everyone I’ve introduced the game to loves it and wants to play more. We are all very excited to August as we will get both Rook City and Infernal Relics as part of our pledge level for the kickstarter. Hell I’ve found myself on multiple occasions discussing strategies with my friends and brother on how to best handle a certain villain in a certain environment. I’m just a player, a new one at that, and I can see how my thoughts are being consumed by this. I can only imagine as the creators how much of your thought processes are taken up. But I’m rambling. I just want to sincerely thank you to you, Adam and Paul but also to this community that is open, knowledgeable and a joy to follow and be a part of.

posts.name: Reckless
posts.cooked:
I put this game on my wishlist for Christmas when The Escapist mentioned it in an article. The folks were kind enough to have it under the tree for me come Christmas day, and within the week I was informed that the store I worked at for four years (my first and only job) was closing and I was going to be laid off. I was crushed. I called up two good friends and told them I just needed to do something fun and wanted to play my new game. We got together, ordered some pizza, and attempted to thwart Baron Blade’s ambitions of moon manipulation in Megalopolis with the powerhouse team of Tempest, Bunker, and Fanatic.

We won, and my spirits were lifted. I shook off the shock of losing my job, and had a new one within two weeks.

Throughout two expansions worth of new characters, those three heroes are still our respective favorites. M’kk Dall’ton will always be remembered as a hero that not only bested the beardiest of big bads for me, but also made the worst day ever end on a note of happiness with my friends. I play Sentinels with no less than three people at least two times a week. Usually more.

Thank you. I hope to tell the three of you that in person someday. If you’re ever close to the Topeka area, I’ll be sure to round up my Sentinels group and show you the support you have in the Kansas capital.

posts.name: Smilinbrax
posts.cooked:
I’m a BGGer at heart, and usually post my thoughts there, but I am more involved here since the play tester option somehow ended up on my kickstarter pledge.

I learned about Sentinels from a post by Frank Branham. I heard about him from stumbling across pictures of his Battle Beyond Space prototype and he just happened to live in the greater Atlanta area. He wasn’t highly impressed by it but one of the people he gamed with, Richard Launius, did and that was all it took for me. I’ve enjoyed many of Richard’s games and have enjoyed playing games with him at his game days or Atlanta gamefest, although you never know if you played the game by the rules as written.

So, long convoluted story short, I only bought Sentinels through a chain of bizarre coincidences and the fact that I respect a designer who liked it. It makes me sad thinking of what minor events could have transpired for me to miss it. But I didn’t and now I’m willing to pay to playtest this game because I enjoy it that much and have that much faith in it. I’ve even written reviews for both it and Rook City on BGG.

I have since moved to California and I’m introducing it around as nobody seemed to have heard of it in NorCal. If you ever need assistance in West Coast promotion let me now. I hate being a fanboy with any game, but I am with Sentinels.

My hat is off to all of you.
